description: This file defines a 'Note' class with methods for serialization, copying, and construction from a map, representing note data in a Flutter application.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Represents a note with properties like id, title, content, timestamps, and categoryId. Provides methods for creating instances from a map, converting instances to a map, and copying with modifications.

methods.name: Note.fromMap
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a Note instance from a map of key-value pairs.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Converts the Note instance into a map, optionally including the id.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Note instance with optional modifications to its properties.
